periscan.config.title: PeriScan
periscan.config.ns_width.desc: Width in columns of the trenches at both Z ends of the perimeter.
periscan.config.ew_width.desc: Width in columns of the trenches at both X ends of the perimeter.
periscan.config.scan_max_y.desc: Scan up to this Y (inclusive). The scan starts just above the bedrock floor (Y = -59 in the Overworld, Y = 5 in the Nether).
periscan.config.schematics_folder.desc: Folder under litematica's schematics directory holding the peri schematic sets. Each set is a subfolder (e.g. "ow") containing "all" (placed once at the min corner) and "edge" (placed as a point-symmetric pair on the corners chosen below).
periscan.config.edge_corners.desc: Which corner pair the edge schematics anchor to. ++ / --: unrotated at the -x/-z corner and rotated 180 degrees at the +x/+z corner. +- / -+: X-flipped at the +x/-z corner and Z-flipped at the -x/+z corner (mirrors instead of 90/270 rotations, so the NS/EW trench directions are preserved). Files in "all" always go untransformed at the -x/-z corner.
periscan.config.show_pending.desc: Draw a chunk-sized box over chunks in the region that have not been scanned yet (not loaded since the region was activated). Only chunks near the camera are drawn.
periscan.config.bottom_trench.desc: In the bottom two scanned layers of the trench area (Y=-59, -58 in the overworld), every block except air and liquids is highlighted. Those two layers are excluded from the "inside the trench" checks (block list and falling-block runs).
periscan.config.zone.enabled.desc: When OFF this zone is not scanned or highlighted. A scan cannot start while all zones are OFF.
periscan.config.eater.include_trench.des: ON: the eater zone covers the whole specified region including the trenches. OFF: only the interior with the trenches removed.
periscan.config.falling_run.desc: Inside the trench, highlight spots where at least this many falling blocks (sand, gravel, concrete powder, ...) run consecutively along the trencher's direction of travel (the trench's long axis). Air, liquids and blocks destroyed by a piston push (dripstone, ...) don't count but don't interrupt the run either; only other blocks end it.
periscan.config.zone.waterlogged.desc: Also highlight waterlogged blocks in this zone. Plain water sources are never highlighted.
periscan.config.waterlogged_exclude_push: Exclude push-destroyed blocks from waterlogged check
Blocks destroyed by a piston push (leaves, coral, pointed dripstone, ...) are not highlighted as waterlogged. Shared by all zones.
periscan.config.waterlogged_blacklist.de: Blocks (id or #tag) never highlighted as waterlogged, in addition to the automatic exclusion. Shared by all zones.
periscan.config.zone.blocks.desc: Block ids (minecraft:obsidian) or block tags (#minecraft:walls). The special entry #periscan:immovable matches every block a piston cannot move: blocks with a block entity (chests, spawners, sculk sensors, ...) and blocks that refuse pushes (obsidian, reinforced deepslate, ...). Bedrock is excluded (it is terrain, not an obstruction).
periscan.config.zone.fence_blocks.desc: Blocks in this list are only highlighted in trench columns whose 1-based index from the perimeter edge has remainder 2 when divided by 3 (2, 5, 8, 11...). In other columns they do not obstruct the trencher and are ignored. Width-3 trenches survive them even in the middle column, so nothing is highlighted there. Special entries: #periscan:connecting matches blocks whose shape connects to horizontal neighbors (walls, fences, glass panes, iron bars); #periscan:redstone_reactive matches blocks with a redstone-driven state property - powered/open/extended/triggered/enabled (doors, trapdoors, fence gates, copper bulbs, pistons, dispensers, hoppers, observers, ...).
periscan.config.invalid_entries.title: PeriScan: invalid block entries
periscan.config.invalid_entries.message: Not a block id or tag (saved anyway, %s): %s
periscan.msg.region_too_large: PeriScan: the perimeter is %s x %s chunks. Each side can be at most %s chunks.
periscan.msg.no_profiles: PeriScan: no profiles yet. Create one with /peri add <x1> <z1> <x2> <z2> <name>.
periscan.msg.wrong_dimension: PeriScan: profile '%s' belongs to %s. Run this command in that dimension.
periscan.msg.no_last_profile: PeriScan: nothing scanned yet. Run /peri scan start <name> first.
periscan.msg.end_not_supported: PeriScan: peris are not built in the end; this command cannot be used here.
periscan.msg.litematica_missing: PeriScan: litematica is not installed (or is an incompatible version), so schematic placement is unavailable.
periscan.msg.unsupported_dimension: PeriScan: no origin height is defined for %s. Only the overworld and the nether are supported.
periscan.msg.schem_no_files: PeriScan: no .litematic files in the all / edge subfolders of %s
periscan.msg.schem_edge_unsorted: PeriScan: %s has .litematic files directly in edge. In a nether set they must be sorted into edge/mx (X-flip pair) or edge/mz (Z-flip pair).
periscan.msg.schem_load_failed: PeriScan: failed to load %s - no placements were created
periscan.msg.region_available: PeriScan: a saved profile is available. Run /peri scan reload in its dimension to start scanning.
periscan.msg.unknown_tag: PeriScan: this world has no tag %s, so it matches nothing. Check the spelling.
periscan.msg.pending_chunks: PeriScan: %s chunks not loaded yet - approach them to scan
periscan.msg.all_disabled: PeriScan: all zones are disabled. Enable at least one zone in the config.
